Built in the neoclassical style after the 1755 earthquake, it features a grand façade with sculptures and a notable central staircase designed by José Luís Monteiro. results.summary: The Camões Monument stands in Luís de Camões Square in Chiado, honoring Portugal’s national poet Luis de Camões. Unveiled in 1867, the bronze statue is set on a lioz limestone pillar surrounded by eight smaller figures of notable figures from the Age of Discoveries. It was sculpted by Victor Bastos and inaugurated in the presence of King Luís I and Ferdinand II.
